sources.entry: Github contributions - GitHub contributions app, for iOS, WatchOS, and macOS.

summary.one_liner: An Apple-platform app for viewing your GitHub contribution activity on iOS, Apple Watch, and macOS, with widgets and complications.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes GitHub contributions as an app for following your own GitHub contributions. It is available for iOS, with a widget extension. It is available for Apple Watch, with a complication for the home screen. It is available for OS X, with a widget in the notification panel. The README is very short and does not describe setup, configuration, or internals beyond these platform-level features.
use_cases: track my GitHub contributions on iPhone
see contribution activity on Apple Watch
GitHub contribution widget on Mac notification panel
monitor coding activity from a phone home screen
notable: Covers iOS, Apple Watch, and macOS from one project
macOS widget in the notification panel
caveats: README is very brief; no installation or build instructions are given
Stack details beyond the named platforms are not stated in the README
License not stated in the README
